title: Collection Tradeline Furnishing Standard for Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Credit Reporting team standard for **Placed Consumer Accounts**: when Ridgeline furnishes a collection tradeline to the consumer reporting agencies, what an initial report requires, and which tradeline action follows each later event.

## A. Authority to furnish

A1. Ridgeline furnishes collection tradelines to the consumer reporting agencies only for its own placements.
A2. An account is furnished to the credit bureaus only when its stage furnishes tradelines and the placing agreement authorizes credit reporting. Both facts are read from Ridgeline's records: the stage of the account and the placing agreement.
A3. Tradeline actions are furnished only for accounts whose status is validation period, active, arranged, dispute hold, hardship hold, paid in full, settled in full or returned to client.

## B. The initial report

An initial report is furnished only when every one of these holds:

| Requirement | Detail |
|---|---|
| Wait after the validation notice | The handling date is on or after the reporting wait counted from the date the validation notice was sent. The wait is the stage's figure in calendar days, the day after the notice date being day one, and the report may go on the last day. |
| Medical wait (medical debts only) | The handling date is on or after the medical wait counted from the account's first delinquency date. The medical wait is 365 calendar days, the day after the first delinquency date being day one; the report may go on the last day. |
| Minimum balance | The balance due is at or above the minimum for the debt type (table below). |
| Status | The account is active or arranged. |
| Hardship holds | No hardship hold on the account whose tier suspends new credit reporting. |
| Obsolescence | The handling date is before the obsolescence date: the first delinquency date plus 180 calendar days plus 7 years. After the obsolescence date only a deletion may be furnished. |

**Minimum balance for an initial report**

| Debt type | Minimum balance due |
|---|---|
| Medical | $500.00 |
| Bank card | $100.00 |
| Utility | $100.00 |
| Telecom | $100.00 |
| Auto deficiency | $250.00 |
| Private student loan | $250.00 |
| Retail installment | $100.00 |

## C. Live tradelines and later actions

C1. A tradeline is live from its initial report until a tradeline deletion.
C2. A dispute received on an account with a live tradeline is flagged with a dispute flag within the stage's dispute flag time, in business days after the dispute's date, and the flag is removed when the verification answering that dispute is mailed.
C3. When an account with a live tradeline becomes paid in full or settled in full, a paid status update is furnished within the stage's paid status update time, except that a medical debt receives a tradeline deletion instead.
C4. When an account with a live tradeline is returned to the client for any reason, a tradeline deletion is furnished within the stage's deletion time, in business days after the date the account was closed.
C5. A hardship hold whose tier calls for a disaster special comment is reported with a special comment.
C6. Live tradelines otherwise receive a monthly update in the file sent on the stage's monthly file day. The reporting period of every action is always the year and month of the date the action was furnished.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

*Primary Placement's 35-day wait from the Placed Consumer Accounts reporting settings; all dates and balances invented.*

- Notice sent 2026-03-02: day one is 2026-03-03 and day 35 is 2026-04-06. An initial report may go on 2026-04-06, not on 2026-04-05.
- Medical debt with first delinquency date 2025-03-10: day 365 is 2026-03-10. Handling date 2026-03-10 meets the medical wait; 2026-03-09 does not.
- A medical account with a balance due of $499.99 does not meet the $500.00 minimum; at $500.00 it does.
- First delinquency date 2019-05-01: adding 180 calendar days gives 2019-10-28, and adding 7 years gives an obsolescence date of 2026-10-28. An initial report requires a handling date before 2026-10-28.
- A medical account with a live tradeline is paid in full: it receives a tradeline deletion, not a paid status update.
